test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the meaning of the medals "Tong Xin" given at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Together as One.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Beijing 2022 medals- named" Tong Xin", meaning" together as one"** is composed of five rings and a center; the design is grounded on Chinese ancient wanton concentric circle pendants with the **five rings representing the Olympic spirit to bring people together and the splendor** of the Olympic Winter Games being participated all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Beijing 2022 marked** India’s 11th Winter Olympics appearance.**
 
• Compared to the Summer Games, where the country has featured in 25 editions, India’s tryst with the Winter Olympics has been relatively few and far between.
 
• Though the Winter Games began way back in 1924, it took India 40 years to put up its first athlete in the quadrennial showpiece.
 
• At** Beijing 2022, Indian alpine skier Arif Mohammad Khan won quotas in both men’s slalom and giant slalom **– making him the first Indian to qualify for two separate events directly.
